# Essentia Wellness Club — Complete Reference

> Essentia is a longevity centre and social wellness club in Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain. Today it offers manual therapies, therapeutic facials and IV therapy, booked online and given at the centre.

---

## Contact and location

- **Address:** Rambla de Santa Cruz, 83, 38004 Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain
- **Map:** https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Rambla+de+Santa+Cruz+83%2C+38004+Santa+Cruz+de+Tenerife
- **Website:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com
- **Email:** info@essentiawellnessclub.com
- **Phone:** +34 634 09 12 95
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/essentiamassage
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/essentia
- **Reception hours:** 08:00–17:00
- **Languages:** English and Spanish (the Spanish pages are under /es/)

---

## Booking and prices

- **Booking:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/booking — choose the service, the treatment, the day and the hour, and pay the full price online.
- **Where:** every session takes place at the centre.
- **Prices:** Prices are not listed in this file. The centre changes them, and the current price of each treatment is on its own page, under its name, next to how long it lasts.
- **Payment and cancellation:** The full price is paid online when booking. A booking can be changed or cancelled up to 24 hours before the session, and a cancellation made at least 24 hours ahead is refunded; within the last 24 hours, or for a no-show, there is no refund.

---

## Manual Therapies

- **URL:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies
- **Description:** Precise manual work to release tension and restore mobility.
- **Note:** All our therapies use premium oils and essences, with carefully chosen aromatherapy to lift the sensory experience and support the manual work. Where there are allergies, sensitivities or a personal preference, the aromatherapy can be adapted or left out.

### Espira

- **Session:** 30 min
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies/espira
- **Description:** Relaxing massage focused on the upper body — neck, shoulders, cervical area and back. It closes with craniofacial work to settle the nervous system and bring back calm, lightness and presence.

### Pulse

- **Session:** 45 min
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies/pulse
- **Description:** Deep tissue therapeutic massage, made to ease knots, reduce muscular stiffness and give the body back its mobility when rest alone no longer shifts the tension.

### Integrative Lymphatic Drainage — Essentia Method

- **Session:** 50 min
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies/drenaje-linfatico
- **Description:** The Método Essentia brings together precision, rhythm and a therapist's eye to follow processes of inflammation, fluid retention and heaviness, building a greater sense of lightness and balance.

### Essentia Active

- **Session:** 45 min
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies/essentia-active
- **Description:** Recovery massage for tired or overloaded legs. Made to ease heaviness, bring back lightness and look after legs under physical strain.

### Nurtura

- **Session:** 50 min
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies/nurtura
- **Description:** A gentle, safe prenatal massage, designed to ease tension and swelling and support the body through pregnancy.

### Serenna

- **Session:** 50 min
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies/serenna
- **Description:** Full-body relaxation: warm oils and slow movements to reset the nervous system.

### Soléa

- **Session:** 70 min
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies/solea
- **Description:** Post-sun ritual with aloe vera and full-body massage to calm, hydrate and restore the skin after sun exposure.

### Soma

- **Session:** 60 min
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies/soma
- **Description:** Full-body deep tissue massage, aimed at persistent tension, muscular stiffness and overloaded areas, working towards mobility and a sense of release.

### Lume

- **Session:** 80 min
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies/lume
- **Description:** A full-body multisensory experience combining massage, craniofacial work and foot reflexology to bring a deep disconnection and carry the body towards calm, rest and balance.

### Alure Duo

- **Session:** 50 min
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies/alure-duo
- **Description:** A ritual for two bodies after time, presence and calm. A shared experience of care and connection.

### Essentia Signature

- **Session:** 120 min
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/wellness/manual-therapies/essentia-signature
- **Description:** Our most complete ritual: exfoliation, hydrating wrap, rejuvenating facial and full-body massage for a premium renewal experience.

## IV Therapy

- **URL:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy
- **Description:** Personalised intravenous protocols with vitamins, minerals and micronutrients, always under medical assessment.
- **Note:** Intravenous protocols are always given under medical assessment and supervision. They do not replace medical treatment or a balanced diet, and they are not suitable for everyone.

### Essentia IV Signature

- **Session:** LYMPHATIC DRAINAGE + IV THERAPY
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy/essentia-iv-signature
- **Description:** Integrative Lymphatic Drainage — Essentia Method combined with a formula developed with VitalDrip: NAD+, magnesium, vitamin C and L-carnitine.

### Power Drip

- **Session:** 45–60 MIN
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy/power-drip
- **Description:** An intravenous protocol for low-energy spells, demanding days or periods of strain. B-group vitamins, B12, amino acids and magnesium to support vitality and recovery.

### Immunity Drip

- **Session:** 45–60 MIN
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy/immunity-drip
- **Description:** Vitamin C, zinc, B-group vitamins and glutathione, designed as nutritional support during demanding periods and for the normal functioning of the immune system.

### Nirvana Drip

- **Session:** 45–60 MIN
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy/nirvana-drip
- **Description:** Focused on relaxation and wellbeing during stressful periods or poor sleep. Magnesium, B-group vitamins and tryptophan to support calm and recovery.

### Stress Balance

- **Session:** 45–60 MIN
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy/stress-balance
- **Description:** For stress, mental tension or insufficient rest. Magnesium, B vitamins, vitamin C, glycine and zinc to support relaxation and wellbeing.

### Beauty & Hair Glow

- **Session:** 45–60 MIN
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy/beauty-hair-glow
- **Description:** Skin and hair cared for from within. Biotin, zinc, vitamin C, glutathione and selected amino acids within an experience aimed at aesthetic wellbeing.

### Vitamin C

- **Session:** 45–60 MIN
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy/vitamin-c
- **Description:** A high-concentration vitamin C protocol for antioxidant support and general wellbeing. A specific option, always chosen after individual medical assessment.

### NAD+

- **Session:** 45–60 MIN
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy/nad-plus
- **Description:** Focused on cellular performance, mental clarity and energy recovery. It can also be added to any other protocol as a boost.

### Resurrection Drip

- **Session:** 45–60 MIN
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy/resurrection-drip
- **Description:** Hydration and recovery for periods of strain. Saline solution, B-group vitamins, vitamin C, magnesium and zinc to support rehydration.

### Body Drip

- **Session:** 45–60 MIN
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy/body-drip
- **Description:** MIC complex, B-group vitamins and alpha lipoic acid, approached from a metabolic and body-composition perspective.

### Fit Drip

- **Session:** 45–60 MIN
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy/fit-drip
- **Description:** For physical activity, recovery and demanding periods. Essential amino acids, B-group vitamins, magnesium and calcium to support hydration and recovery.

### Calm Drip

- **Session:** 45–60 MIN
- **Page and current price:** https://www.essentiawellnessclub.com/medicine/intravenous-therapy/calm-drip
- **Description:** Aimed at rest and relaxation, especially in stressful periods. Tryptophan, magnesium, glutathione and essential amino acids to support calm and recovery.
